# apple_retention_message_localization (Resource)

Sets the header and body text of a retention message version for one locale. A version has one localization per locale, and an approved version takes no new localizations: create a new `apple_retention_message_version` to change approved content. Destroying the resource deletes the localization. Import it by ID or with `<retention_message_version_id>/<locale>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_retention_message_localization" "en_US" {
  retention_message_version_id = apple_retention_message_version.first.id
  locale                       = "en-US"
  header                       = "Your cortado is waiting"
  body                         = "Stay subscribed and keep your daily cortado coming."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`. Changing it creates a new localization.
- `retention_message_version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the retention message version, e.g. `apple_retention_message_version.example.id`. Changing it creates a new localization.

### Optional

- `body` (String) Body of the message, up to 144 characters.
- `header` (String) Header of the message, up to 66 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_retention_message_localization.en_US
  identity = {
    id = "5931204487"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id> or <retention_message_version_id>/<locale>
terraform import apple_retention_message_localization.en_US 4820193376/en-US
```
